description: Records how good the last teleprompter output was, from 1 to 10, so the prompter's own learning loop improves the next script. Side effect: it writes one rating into the learning store of the site; the script itself is not changed. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` and `rating`; `note` says what was good or bad in the host's words. Use it right after reading a script with wi_get_webinar_prompter, and write a new one with wi_write_webinar_prompter once the rating is in.

note.description: What was good or bad, in the host's own words.

rating.description: How good the output was, 1 (unusable) to 10 (perfect).

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_rate_webinar_prompter
title: Rate a teleprompter script
